description: A private spa the size of an ordinary apartment, walled floor-to-ceiling in book-matched marble that runs unbroken from the wet-room floor up into the five-metre dark. One whole wall is glass, the bay and the mountains laid out and unable to look back in, and a monolithic soaking tub sits cut from a single block of that same stone, deep enough to vanish into. A frameless rain shower and a hidden steam vent stand off to one side; a floating basin, a concealed toilet, warm bronze fittings that have never dripped. The floor is heated, the air is soft, and nothing up here makes a sound it doesn't mean to. The privacy bolt seats with a single soft note, like a struck bell.

window.description: A high slot of frosted glass under the ceiling. It lets the day in and nobody look back.
window.name: the frosted slot
